## Wave 5 Summary

Wave 5 lands four **bridge-SPEC** gates from the S103 research-sweep gem triage (holography, qg-tabletop, topological-matter mines). The wave theme is the S103 W4 lesson made into a discipline: each of these four gems is a candidate cross-pillar bridge whose construction is NOT yet known to be operator-explicit on the substrate. Rather than force a numerical bridge gate on an unpinned construction (the iterate-until-named failure mode), every gate here pre-registers a SPEC-completeness predicate. **The deliverable is the spec, not the bridge.** A spec-gate PASSes iff the construction is NAMEABLE — its substrate-IS object, its computation path, and a 4-field S105 compute spec are all written down with no unpinned ingredient; FAILs iff the construction is unnameable, in which case the corridor is documented closed at the spec level (the honest S103-W4-style NOT-DISPATCHABLE declaration); INFOs per a pre-registered intermediate when the identity is stateable but a single named ingredient is unpinned. No gate here may emit a numerical PASS/FAIL on the bridge physics itself — that is the S105 compute's job, gated on this wave's PASS.

The four gates are mutually independent at the substrate-physics level (different pillars, different executors) and share no input pins. Item 4 (loop-counting envelope) carries an ADJACENCY FLAG to the Wave-1 L_max carry-forwards (`S104-VIIAM-L11-ANCHOR`, `S104-BRANCH-IV-DIRECT-L1314`) per dedup-ledger (c) of the gem triage — joint-consideration only, no shared pins, no double-scheduling.

## Wave 5 Decision Point Prerequisites

None of the four W5 gates consume a mid-session (S104) prior-wave verdict. Each composes with ALREADY-LANDED canonical state (verified at plan-freeze via the knowledge MCP — see each block's `machinery_pin_map` provenance + the Input-SHA ledger). The composed-with results these gates must NOT redo:

| Gate | Composes with (verified PASS/INFO; do NOT recompute) |
|:-----|:-----------------------------------------------------|
| W5-1 | `S97-DS-AREA-LAW-MONOTONICITY` (INFO, `independent=False`, `a2_cancels=True`, `dS/d(a0a2) sign=−1`); `S97-VN-TYPE-INDUCTIVE-LIMIT` (PASS, Type-I_∞) |
| W5-2 | `G_N = 1/(16π a_2 M_KK²)` (canonical); two-layer split `a_0`→CC / `a_2`→Newton (PROVEN, spectral-moment decoupling S75 W2-E); `GRAV-BACKREACT-63` (O(G_N²), NOT a which-path computation) |
| W5-3 | `LEGGETT-MOMENT-70` (PROVEN, `Ω_DM h²=0.1200`, `Mass_LeggettDM/Δ_BCS=11.97`); `LEGGETT-GRAV-DECAY-67` / `LEGGETT-GRAV-DECAY-CONDITIONAL` (PASS, `Γ_grav/H_0 ~ 8.85e-66`); massless Goldstone (S48) |
| W5-4 | `S94-MULT-NORM-CANCELLATION-K3` (PASS, MANDATORY K=3); `§VII.AF.1` L^{-3} Level-2-binding bridge (the registry-eligible parallel); the standing L_max CFs (ADJACENCY ONLY) |

If at dispatch any of these composed-with results is found NOT in the state the block asserts, the gate honestly closes (FAIL-with-remediation) per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` rather than proceeding on a stale pin.

# (7) substitution_chain — the binding-vs-identity determination is the gem's sharp directional claim; pin it
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim under test (the gem's SHARP discriminator, the spec's deliverable): "the loop-counting
    finite-size exponent is EITHER a Level-2-BINDING independent derivation of the L^{-alpha} envelope
    (new structure, registry-eligible) OR merely an F-image of the multiplicative-normalization-
    cancellation identity (NOT new structure, registry-INELIGIBLE)."
    This wave DETERMINES which; it does NOT fit the exponent numerically (that is S105).

    Step 1 (Definition): the substrate's L_max-robustness is the MANDATORY-K=3 multiplicative-
      normalization-cancellation theorem: f^{(L_max)}(K) = w(L_max).g(K), g(K) L_max-INDEPENDENT, so
      any log-derivative operator annihilates w(L_max) -> the plateau is a STRUCTURAL IDENTITY, not
      empirical regulator-class evidence. [source: S94-MULT-NORM-CANCELLATION-K3 PASS; math-scripts.md]
    Step 2 (Definition): Level-2-BINDING (cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md) := an L^{-alpha} rate that
      operationally bounds ||HKR(c_L) - c_continuum|| for a DEFINED reference quantity c_continuum,
      via an HKR / Connes-Karoubi / K-theory boundary image. Level-2-NON-binding := a bare-decomposition
      rate, no HKR image, c_continuum undefined (registry-PASS-INELIGIBLE).
    Step 3 (Definition): the loop-counting law (Zhong 2604.27585) := a finite-size correction theory
      pinning non-Hermitian spectral-moment deviations to "missing boundary loops" with a verified
      scaling law alpha_loop.
    Step 4 (Substitution — the discriminator, evaluated structurally this wave):
      substitute the substrate's f^{(L_max)} = w(L_max).g(K) into the loop-counting law.
        Case (B): if the loop-counting alpha_loop reduces to the cancellation identity (the missing-
          boundary-loop correction IS the w(L_max) prefactor's L-dependence), then there is no HKR image,
          c_continuum is undefined -> Level-2-NON-binding -> registry-PASS-INELIGIBLE -> alpha_loop is an
          F-image of the K=3 identity, NOT new structure.
        Case (A): if the loop-counting alpha_loop bounds ||HKR(c_L) - c_continuum|| for a DEFINED
          c_continuum (the continuum-limit moment of an HKR image, distinct from the substrate ratio
          identically being 1), then it is Level-2-BINDING -> registry-eligible -> a genuinely DISTINCT,
          lab-anchored derivation of the envelope exponent.
    Step 5 (Direction / what PASS asserts): PASS asserts ONLY that the (A)/(B) classification is MADE
      with the discriminator pre-registered (Step 2), the c_continuum reference named (A) or its absence
      recorded (B), and an S105 numerical-binding-determination spec emitted. PASS does NOT assert
      alpha_loop EQUALS the §VII.AF.1 L^{-3} exponent numerically -- that comparison is the S105 compute.
    Conclusion: spec-completeness = (binding class determined per the pre-registered discriminator) AND
      (c_continuum named or its absence recorded) AND (S105 spec emitted). The decisive caveat is honored
      by construction: a (B) determination still PASSes the SPEC gate (the spec is complete) but its S105
      routing is "confirm non-binding -> the envelope question is internal, not bridgeable" rather than a
      registry-landing compute.

# The binding-class determination IS the Level-2 sub-class declaration this rule mandates.
cross_pillar_bridge_anatomy:

Single-tau-slice + moduli-deformation levels both apply (the K=3 corpus spans both)."
  element_2_laboratory_IN: "PARTIAL — the loop-counting finite-size scaling of non-Hermitian spectral moments in Zhong's skin-effect acoustic lattice. OE-form for any S105 moment-deviation observable must be made explicit."
  element_3_bridge_map: "THE DISCRIMINATOR — an HKR / Connes-Karoubi image is REQUIRED for (A) Level-2-binding; its existence-or-absence is exactly the spec's binding-class determination. NO bridge map named -> (B) non-binding -> registry-INELIGIBLE."
  element_4_algebraic_envelope: "THIS IS THE SUBJECT — the L^{-alpha} envelope itself. The spec determines its SUB-CLASS (binding vs non-binding) per cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §'Level-2 sub-class'; the numerical exponent fit is the S105 compute."
  element_5_empirical_anchor: "MISSING (deferred to S105) — the numerical alpha_loop and its comparison to the §VII.AF.1 L^{-3} exponent at canonical L_max is the S105 deliverable, NOT this gate's."
  three_level_status: "Level 1 (the multiplicative-cancellation identity) is ALREADY PROVEN (K=3). Level 2 sub-class (binding vs non-binding) is what THIS spec determines -- and a NON-binding determination is itself a complete spec result (the corridor is internal, not bridgeable). Level 3 (empirical anchor) is the S105 deliverable. Per the DECISIVE CAVEAT: a non-binding outcome means NO registry landing; a binding outcome licenses an S105 registry-landing compute."

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "The loop-counting exponent is classified (A) Level-2-BINDING (HKR/Connes-Karoubi image + defined c_continuum named) or (B) Level-2-NON-binding (reduces to the K=3 cancellation identity, c_continuum recorded undefined) per the pre-registered discriminator, AND a 4-field S105 compute spec is emitted. Solution-space: (A) gives the framework a candidate empirically-anchored derivation of its truncation-envelope exponent (directly relevant to the standing CAC-spread / L_max-convergence CFs) and licenses an S105 registry-landing compute; (B) confirms the envelope question is purely internal (the multiplicative-cancellation identity) with no lab-anchored bridge -- sharpening that the L_max axis is internal, not bridgeable. BOTH are complete spec results."
FAIL_meaning: "The loop-counting construction cannot be mapped onto the substrate's L^{-alpha} envelope at all (neither a binding HKR image nor a reduction to the cancellation identity can be named -- e.g. the loop-counting law's spectral-moment definition has no substrate analog on the Hermitian D_K). Solution-space: the corridor closes honestly at the spec level -- the lab-anchored envelope sibling is not constructible; the framework's envelope discipline remains the Friedrich-Baer / multiplicative-cancellation internal account with no bridge."
INFO_meaning: "The loop-counting exponent is STATEABLE as an envelope candidate but the binding-class discriminator is undecided at spec-time (pre-registered intermediate: the HKR-image existence cannot be settled without the numerical reduction -- i.e. whether substituting f^{(L_max)} = w(L_max).g(K) reproduces alpha_loop is the very thing the S105 compute decides). The spec reserves the corridor with the binding determination flagged as the S105 prerequisite; the §VII slot is NOT registry-PASS-eligible until the binding class is settled (registry-INCOMPLETE-PENDING per cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md)."

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/_shared/s104_loop_counting_envelope_spec.py"
    - "computations/session-104/s104_loop_counting_envelope_spec.npz"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The L^{-alpha} truncation envelope is a property of the fabric itself: how the finite-L
  spectral triple (A_K^{<=L}, H_K^{<=L}, D_K^{<=L}) converges to the continuum image as L grows. The
  arrow flows FROM the substrate: D_K spectral moments at finite L -> their L_max-robustness (the
  multiplicative-cancellation identity, K=3) -> (candidate) lab-anchored loop-counting envelope. The
  substrate's L_max-robustness is NOT empirical regulator-class evidence -- it is a STRUCTURAL IDENTITY
  (the log-derivative annihilates the w(L_max) prefactor). The gem asks whether a laboratory non-
  Hermitian acoustic lattice supplies a DISTINCT, binding derivation of the envelope EXPONENT, or
  whether the loop-counting law is just an F-image of the same identity. Crucially, the laboratory
  lattice is a PROJECTION of the substrate truncation, not the other way around (IS space, not IN
  space): the substrate IS the spectral triple whose moments are robust; the skin-effect lattice
  MODELS a simplified shadow of that robustness. Container-thinking ("the lab measures a real envelope
  and the substrate must reproduce it") inverts to the substrate reading ("the substrate's envelope is
  the K=3 identity; the question is whether the lab's loop-counting is a binding bridge to it or a
  re-derivation of it"). The binding-class determination is the spec's whole point.
